name: Vensim
description: System dynamics modelling and simulation software developed by Ventana Systems, used for building causal loop diagrams and stock-and-flow models of complex feedback systems. Vensim is widely applied in policy analysis, environmental modelling, and business dynamics.
reputation: Gold-standard system dynamics tool in academic and policy circles; used extensively in sustainability, public health, and corporate strategy research.
notes: Commercial product with a free PLE version; model outputs are deterministic given parameters, but parameter elicitation for real systems introduces uncertainty.
